sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the unrelated frameProfileType constraint and do not impose xsd:decimal/kN validation on combinedShearAndBendingDemand: its supplied canonical record has no declared quantity kind or recommended unit. Retain the required decimal/kN checks for midspanPlasticCollapseLoad and ship-owned plasticStrength, and compare each represented applicable load-case demand against the tolerance-validated plastic strength.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the unrelated frameProfileType constraint. Replace StructuralMemberRuleShape's sh:or with conditional constraints that apply only when the same structural member has longitudinalFrameOrientation true and structuralLocation sideStructureLocation. The current alternatives wrongly impose orientation/location classifications on irrelevant members, treat bottomStructureLocation as an unsupported exemption, and let a member that also has bottomStructureLocation bypass required collapse-load and load-case evidence despite being side-located. For each applicable member require midspanPlasticCollapseLoad in kN and validate every represented hasStructuralMemberLoadCase demand in kN; retain no minCount for load cases themselves. Keep the ship-owned plasticStrength and its tolerance-based equality to the applicable member's collapse load, and compare each represented demand against it.

Add the omitted COMPLETE dependency-contract relationship nltl:frameProfileType, validated on its declared owner ship; do not relocate it to the structural member. Preserve the existing ship-to-member and member-to-load-case paths and member/load-case property ownership.

Remove the unrelated frameProfileType constraint and do not impose xsd:decimal/kN validation on combinedShearAndBendingDemand: its supplied canonical record has no declared quantity kind or recommended unit. Retain the required decimal/kN checks for midspanPlasticCollapseLoad and ship-owned plasticStrength, and compare each represented applicable load-case demand against the tolerance-validated plastic strength.
